name: Merman
source:
A shy mermaid who seems both fascinated and frightened by humans.

Agency assessment: Given its strict living requirements, this species is only suitable for those residing by the sea. Due to high level of casualties, this species was initially rejected from the program. All members should proceed with extreme caution and should refrain from sensory contact unless given expressed permission.

[From [url=https://sunlit-dreamer.itch.io/whats-your-name]itch.io[/url]]

[spoiler]His name is Judicael[/spoiler].
